name: Example EnergyPlus Complex Project
description: Complex building performance simulation with the EnergyPlus backend, based on the DigitalHub IFC. Uses custom usage conditions and template-based wall/window constructions. IFC path should be updated to match your local repository location.
notes: Based on examples/e2_complex_project_energyplus.py. Requires a working EnergyPlus installation with ep_install_path set correctly (see Advanced Settings) since run_full_simulation is enabled. The original example set weather_file_path to the .mos variant, which appears to be a copy-paste inconsistency since EnergyPlus requires .epw; this template uses the .epw file instead. Decisions such as space boundary generator, proxy handling and construction year are no longer pre-answered here -- they will appear as interactive decisions in the Decisions tab when the project is executed, since the GUI uses the WebGUIDecisionHandler instead of the DebugDecisionHandler used in the original script.
